descripcion: At A2 you tell a very simple story in the past simple, using first and then as the only structure needed. Story structure with a turning point comes at higher levels, once this basic sequence is solid.

filas: Last year, I went to Rome.

ejemplos.texto: Last year, I went to Rome for the first time.
First I visited the Colosseum, then I had lunch.
It was a really great trip.

notas: First and then are enough to show a simple order of events.
Most verbs go in the past simple.
A time expression at the start (last year) helps place the story.

contraste.es: Primero and luego correspond to first and then, and the indefinido maps onto the past simple, so simple stories transfer directly.
contraste.de: German tells spoken stories in the Perfekt, which leads to Yesterday I have seen…. English uses the past simple: Yesterday I saw….
contraste.it: Italian tells stories in the passato prossimo, which leads to Yesterday I have seen…. English uses the past simple: Yesterday I saw….
contraste.fr: French tells stories in the passé composé, which leads to Yesterday I have seen…. English uses the past simple: Yesterday I saw….
contraste.pt: Portuguese tells stories in the simple past (ontem vi…), which maps directly onto the English past simple (Yesterday I saw…).

errores: Using the present tense instead of the past simple.
Telling the story with no order at all.
autochequeo: Is the order of events clear?
Are the verbs in the past simple?
Have I closed the story with an evaluation?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on the simple order of events and the past simple tense. Do not rewrite the text. Check whether the response fits the suggestion. Flag anything unclear.
